notes: Clustered against the byte-exact Shop_SelectPartyMember template by the family scan on raw n-gram/branch similarity, but the retained assembly is almost entirely straight-line setup/teardown code with only one small 4-way status chain (via three Func_080770c0(id) checks) -- it does not share the template's redraw/input-poll loop shape at all. This is the clearest case among this batch of a family-transplant lead that does not hold up structurally; the template was useful only for compiler-idiom orientation (constant folding via movs+lsls, the ADDR-pointer-dereference pattern), not for its control flow.

Recovered call sequence and a handful of confirmed literal-pool offsets: a context pointer from Func_080048b0(55, 0xa70) used as the base for most later field writes (offset 388/0x184 to store a second context from Func_08004970, offsets 28/29/372/374/376/0x148 written during teardown-prep), a global mode byte at (0x03001e68 + 0x20c) saved before the call sequence and restored at the very end via the caller-visible r9 register, a pointer stored at address 0x02000240 whose halfword at +4 is set to a small status value (1 by default, overwritten by the branch chain) on entry and cleared on exit, and three status codes (14/27/28) selected by nested Func_080770c0 checks against ids that resolve to small integers rather than shop-relative offsets (0x2130/0x212c/0x2128 in the retained literal pool).

(2) the *(ptr+4) store uses the same register that separately holds a local 'status' variable already initialized to 1, not a fresh literal -- the reference's 'mov r2,sl' / 'mov r3,sl' pattern only makes sense if the source declares and initializes 'status = 1' once and reads it back rather than re-materializing the literal on each branch.

This owner has the most unresolved literal-pool arithmetic of the six assigned: two pool addresses used as an offset pair added to the Func_08004970 return value (guessed here as +0 and +0x60, unverified), the exact field offsets touched during the drawn-out teardown block (0x148/372/374/376/28/29 on the ctx base, unverified against real pool values), and the two Func_080072f8 destination/size arguments near the end (VRAM-shaped constants 0x06004000/0x000020a8/0x05000080 whose pairing this draft guessed). The 68-byte length gap (440 candidate vs 508 reference) indicates real missing or misshapen statements beyond a few wrong constants, most likely in this teardown block.

Given the volume of genuinely unresolved literal-pool values here, this is better described as an incomplete source-shape recovery than a compiler-internals residual: the next productive step is resolving the pool constants properly (assembling/disassembling the reference per CONTRIBUTING.md's guidance) rather than further guessing, so this is flagged as worth a dedicated follow-up pass rather than permuter search.
